comment: Pinned firmware artifacts for the classic-ESP32 runtime tests (R1.5). Identity = sha256 of the 4 MiB flash image. Built reproducibly by runtime/provision/provision.sh from the pins in versions.env; a rebuild must reproduce these bytes exactly.

micropython.source: MicroPython ESP32_GENERIC v1.29.0 (e67ad6015a0a504c1fec9aa9bbf589d0432ed28e62546f4f8dd8a147f8bd95f6) at 0x1000 of a 4 MiB 0xff-filled image (provision.sh micropython)

TbiR1Scan.source: runtime/firmware/arduino/TbiR1Scan (provision.sh firmware, same pinned toolchain). Sprint 11 R1 slice 6 matrix load. Re-pinned 2026-10-11 (Sprint 12 Gate B, G-2 Patch B, conditionally approved by the PM in the round 5 decision): reproducible rebuild without embedded host paths (five independent clean builds byte-identical, docs/sprints/s12-evidence/gate-b/g2-builds.txt); code identical to the previous image (normalised disassembly, G2-ROUND4.md section 3); behavioural equivalence in G2-EVIDENCE.md, G2-ROUND5.md and G2-FINAL.md.
